sources.title: NCERT Indian Constitution at Work, chapter 5
sources.excerpt: Do both Houses of the Parliament have similar functions? Is there a difference in the powers of the two Houses? Apart from law making, the Parliament is engaged in many other functions. Let us list the functions of the Parliament: ± Legislative Function: The Parliament enacts legislations for the country. Despite being the chief law making body, the Parliament often merely approves legislations.
